t: A Raspberry Pi add-on with two microphones and two speaker outputs.
steps: Find a leftover unit at a reseller or pick the BrainCraft HAT from Adafruit.
Install Raspberry Pi OS on an SD card and boot your Pi.
Press the bonnet onto the Pi's 40-pin header.
Turn on I2C in the Pi settings and check that the sound chip shows up.
Install the seeed-voicecard driver from the Adafruit audio setup page and reboot.
Flip the privacy switch on and plug in headphones.
Record and play back a short clip with the test commands in the guide.
Try the Python audio example from the Adafruit guide.
meta: Wild Open. From $24.95. A few stores.
